title: Use of Nebido® to Assess Tolerability and Treatment Outcomes in Daily Clinical Practice
brief_summary: This is an observational study with a drug called Nebido, a new testosterone replacement therapy, which is available for the treatment of male hypogonadism. The benefit and safety of Nebido have already been thoroughly evaluated through well controlled clinical trials. The main purpose of this observational study is to confirm the established safety profile of Nebido in daily clinical practice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male hypogonadal patients eligible for long-term testosterone therapy who have newly been prescribed Nebido® in accordance with the terms of the marketing authorization

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients presenting with contraindications as stated in the product information
